_comment: SAFE TO EDIT: English screen text. Change the text on the right of the colon only. Keep the same keys in gu.json and hi.json.

common.saveFailed: Could not save. Please check and try again.
common.loadFailed: Could not load data. Please try again.
common.noAccessText: You don't have permission to open this screen in this branch.

login.failed: Login failed. Please check your username and password.
login.otpSent: We sent a 6-digit OTP to your phone {{phone}}. Enter it below.
login.otpFailed: The OTP is wrong or has expired.
login.loggedOutIdle: You were logged out because the screen was not used for a while.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
login.signInHelp: Sign in to continue to your clinic.
login.footer: Secure login · Your data stays in your clinic
login.quote: Care rooted in tradition, managed with ease.

layout.noBranch: You are not assigned to any branch yet. Please ask your admin.

branches.title: Branches
branches.name: Branch name
branches.codeHelp: Short code used in invoice numbers, e.g. AHD
branches.onlyOrgAdmin: Only organization admins can add or edit branches.

rooms.title: Rooms — {{branch}}
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.newType: New room type, e.g. Shirodhara room

staff.title: Staff
staff.passwordRules: At least 10 characters. Don't use only numbers or a common word.
staff.phoneHelp: Login OTP is sent to this number (doctors and admins).
staff.branchRolesHelp: Choose each branch this person works in, and their role there.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.name: Role name
roles.otpHelp: Ask for a one-time password at login (recommended for doctors and admins).
roles.help: A role is a set of permissions. Each staff member gets one role per branch.

schedules.title: Doctor schedules — {{branch}}
schedules.noDoctors: No doctors work in this branch yet. Add a doctor on the Staff screen and give them a role in this branch.

settings.title: Settings
settings.featuresHelp: Switch modules on or off for this branch only. Useful to try a new feature in one branch first.
settings.uhidPrefixHelp: Letters at the start of every patient ID, e.g. AY → AY26-000001
settings.multiBranchHelp: Off: the software works with your main branch only (no branch picker). Turn on when you open a second branch. No data is lost either way.
settings.upiIdHelp: Shown as a QR code on bills, e.g. clinic@okbank

audit.title: Audit log
audit.help: Every login, change and (later) every view, print and share of patient records is recorded here. Entries can never be edited or deleted.

permissions.staff_manage: Add and edit staff, reset passwords
permissions.roles_manage: Add and edit roles and their permissions
permissions.settings_manage: Change clinic settings and feature switches
permissions.appointments_manage: Book, cancel and check in appointments
permissions.billing_charge: Add consultation, services and charges to a patient's OPD bill
permissions.billing_manage: Edit consultation fees and the services & charges list

patients.title: Patients
patients.registerHelp: Fields marked with a star are needed. Everything else can be added later.
patients.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, mobile number or patient ID
patients.noResults: No patient found. Check the spelling or search by mobile number.
patients.empty: No patients yet. Click “Register patient” to add the first one.
patients.emailInvalid: This email address is not valid
patients.guardianHelp: Parent or guardian of the child
patients.cameraError: The camera could not be opened. Allow camera access in the browser, or upload a photo instead.
patients.existingHelp: Type the mobile number or full name to check if this patient is already registered.
patients.possibleDuplicate: This patient may already be registered. Open the record instead of creating a new one.
patients.historyPrivate: Medical history is stored encrypted and is visible only to doctors.
patients.historyHidden: Only doctors can see the full medical history.
patients.consentHelp: Read the text to the patient in their language (or let them read it). Switch on only what the patient agrees to. Treatment consent is needed.
patients.consentRequired: Treatment consent is needed to register the patient.
patients.consentLanguageNote: Consent text is shown in the patient's language: {{language}}
patients.activityHelp: Everyone who opened, changed or downloaded this patient's records.

fields.title: Title
fields.referral_source: How did they hear of us?

patients.draftSaved: Draft kept in this browser tab

documents.help: Old reports, prescriptions and scans. PDF or photos, up to 10 MB.
documents.dropHere: Click or drag a file here
documents.allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG — up to 10 MB
documents.title: Title
documents.cannotView: You can upload documents, but only doctors can open them.

consent.help: Consent for each purpose, as required by the DPDP Act. Records are never changed: every give or withdraw is added to the history.
consent.withdrawRequiredWarning: Without treatment consent the clinic cannot continue treatment. Medical records are still kept as the law requires.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.subtitle: {{n}} on this day
appointments.noSlots: The doctor does not sit on this day in this branch.
appointments.searchPatient: Type name, patient ID or mobile
appointments.patientHelp: New patient? Register them first on the Patients screen.
appointments.noConsent: No message sent: the patient has not given consent for SMS/WhatsApp messages (see the Consent tab).
appointments.chooseDoctorFirst: Choose a doctor to see the free times.
appointments.noDoctors: No doctors in this branch. Add one on the Staff screen.
appointments.confirmNoShow: Mark this patient as "did not come"?
appointments.patientTabHelp: Appointments of this patient in the current branch.

queue.title: Queue
queue.subtitle: Today. Updates by itself every {{seconds}} seconds.
queue.empty: Nobody in the queue today yet.
queue.tvOffline: Cannot reach the clinic server. Retrying...

consult.withoutAppointmentHelp: Search the patient. The check-up is saved under your name in this branch.
consult.appointmentsOff: Appointments are off. Use "Check-up without appointment".
consult.choosePatient: Choose a patient on the left to start the check-up.
consult.completedMsg: Check-up completed. The appointment is marked done.
consult.visitsTabHelp: Check-ups from all branches. Click one to open it.
consult.pressEnterToAdd: Not in the list: press Enter to add your own words.
consult.noneAdded: Nothing added yet. Click a chip above or type and press Enter.
consult.historyPlaceholder: How it started, what makes it better or worse, earlier treatment...
consult.adviceNotesPlaceholder: Anything else to tell the patient
consult.followUpNotesPlaceholder: e.g. Come fasting for sugar test
consult.answerToScore: Answer the questions to see the score.
consult.scoreHelp: How bad is it today? 0 = none, 10 = worst
consult.progressHelp: Symptom score per visit (0 = none, 10 = worst). Add scores in Complaints.
consult.progressEmpty: No scores yet. Give each complaint a score (0-10) in Complaints to track progress.
consult.photoHelp: Photos are private: only staff who can see check-ups can open them. Take photos only with the patient's permission.

templatesAdmin.title: Check-up templates
templatesAdmin.subtitle: Questions the doctor clicks on the check-up screen. Changes create a new version; old check-ups keep their questions.
templatesAdmin.name: Name
templatesAdmin.versionHelp: Now version {{v}}. Saving changed questions makes a new version.
templatesAdmin.questionnaireHelp: Each answer counts for Vata, Pitta or Kapha. The software adds them up into a percentage score.

medicines.title: Medicines
medicines.subtitle: {{n}} medicines · price and on/off are for this branch
medicines.searchPlaceholder: Search any name, synonym or ingredient
medicines.name: Name
medicines.inUseHelp: Switch off to hide it from prescriptions in this branch
medicines.historyHelp: Every saved change. Old prescriptions keep the version that was prescribed.
medicines.classicalHelp: Official name from the Ayurvedic Formulary / Pharmacopoeia of India, with its reference.
medicines.proprietaryHelp: A company's brand. Link it to its classical equivalent if there is one.
medicines.synonymsHelp: Sanskrit, English, Hindi, Gujarati names, separated by commas. Used for searching.
medicines.gstHelp: Confirm the rate with your CA
medicines.safetyNotesPlaceholder: Shown to the doctor when prescribing

flagHelp.schedule_e1: Contains a Schedule E1 (poisonous) ingredient: only on prescription
flagHelp.contains_metals: Rasa / bhasma preparation: avoid long use without monitoring
flagHelp.pregnancy_caution: Warn when the patient is pregnant or breastfeeding

medicines.importHelp: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. Use the template for the right columns.
medicines.dropFile: Click or drop the file here
medicines.dropHint: Existing medicines (same type and name) are updated; new ones are added.
medicines.previewNote: Preview only - nothing is saved yet. Check the list, then click Import.
medicines.barcodeHelp: Scan the product barcode into this box
medicines.allowLooseHelp: Part of a pack can be given

rx.title: Prescription
rx.saveTemplateHelp: Saves these {{n}} medicines with their doses, to use again for the same disease.
rx.templateDiagnosisHelp: Shown first (★) when this diagnosis is chosen
rx.searchMedicine: Search medicine to add (name, synonym, Gujarati / Hindi name)
rx.empty: No medicines yet. Search above, apply a template, or repeat a previous prescription.
rx.instructions: e.g. chew, then drink warm water
rx.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Take with warm water. Stop if loose motions.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.subtitle: Dispense medicines, stock by batch, purchases and suppliers
pharmacy.queueEmpty: No completed prescriptions on this day.
pharmacy.stockEmpty: No stock yet. Click "Add purchase" to enter medicines received.
pharmacy.expiredHelp: {{n}} packs have expired: remove them with Correct
pharmacy.reorderHelp: Shows "Low" when the stock is this many packs or fewer
pharmacy.correctHelp: Now {{n}} in this batch. Use a minus number to remove, plus to add.
pharmacy.purchasesHelp: Medicines received from suppliers. Saving a purchase adds the stock.
pharmacy.noSuppliersYet: Add suppliers on the Suppliers tab (optional).
pharmacy.addLineFirst: Fill medicine, batch, quantity and MRP in at least one line.
pharmacy.suppliersHelp: Who you buy medicines from. Shared by all branches.
pharmacy.checkDoneHelp: Completed on {{date}}. Differences were posted to the stock ledger.
pharmacy.checkHelp: Count what is really on the shelves. On completion the stock is corrected and every difference is recorded.
pharmacy.checkRackHelp: Count one rack at a time, or leave empty for everything.
pharmacy.completeCheckHelp: The stock of every counted batch will be set to the counted quantity. This cannot be undone.
pharmacy.countHelp: Type the counted packs. Save as often as you like; complete when done.
pharmacy.ledgerHelp: Every stock movement with opening and closing balance.
pharmacy.noMovements: No stock movements in this period.
pharmacy.noRacks: No racks yet. Add your racks (A, B, C...) so medicines can be found quickly.
pharmacy.noRacksYet: Add racks first: Pharmacy -> Racks & suppliers.
pharmacy.openingHelp: Enter the stock you already have on the shelves (once, when you start using the software).
pharmacy.purchaseSearch: Invoice no., supplier, medicine or batch
pharmacy.racksHelp: Racks / cupboards in the pharmacy. Give each medicine a rack and shelf on the Stock tab.
pharmacy.returnHelp: Tick the medicines brought back. Sellable ones go back to stock; damaged ones do not.
pharmacy.salesHelp: Medicines given against prescriptions. Use Return when a patient brings medicines back.
pharmacy.scanPlaceholder: Scan barcode or type batch no.
pharmacy.scanUnknown: No medicine with barcode {{code}}. Add the barcode on the Medicines screen.
pharmacy.startCheckHelp: The current stock of every batch is noted. Then count the shelves and type what you find.
pharmacy.supplierReturnPlaceholder: e.g. Damaged in transit, near expiry
pharmacy.supplierReturnsHelp: To return stock: Stock tab -> open a medicine -> Return to supplier on the batch.

billing.cancelHelp: Makes a credit note; medicines go back to stock. The bill is kept.
billing.cancelConfirmHelp: A credit note is made for the whole bill. Money paid is refunded.
billing.noUpiId: Add the branch UPI ID in Settings to show a payment QR code.
billing.upiHelp: After the patient pays, click Take payment -> UPI.
billing.searchPlaceholder: Bill no., patient name or ID

additional.title: Additional settings
additional.subtitle: Optional features for the whole clinic. Switch on only what you need.
additional.keptNote: Switching a feature off only hides it. Nothing already saved is deleted; switch it on again to see it.
additional.onlyAdmin: Only an organization admin can change these switches.

pharmacy_billing.label: Pharmacy bills, payments and printing
pharmacy_billing.help: Dispensing makes a GST bill; take cash / UPI / card payments, print bills, UPI QR code, Bills tab with day closing. Off: medicines are only given, no bill.

pharmacy_discounts.label: Discounts on pharmacy bills
pharmacy_discounts.help: Discount % per medicine or on the whole bill when dispensing.

pharmacy_sales_returns.label: Sales returns
pharmacy_sales_returns.help: Take back medicines a patient returns: sellable ones go back to stock. With bills on, a credit note and refund are made.

pharmacy_loose_sale.label: Sell loose (part of a pack)
pharmacy_loose_sale.help: Sell single tablets from a strip. Set 'Units per pack' and 'Sell loose' on the medicine.

pharmacy_racks.label: Racks and shelf locations
pharmacy_racks.help: Make racks (A, B, C...) and record the rack, shelf and box of each medicine; shown while dispensing and counting.

pharmacy_barcode.label: Barcodes and scanning
pharmacy_barcode.help: Barcode on medicines and batches; scan to find stock, add purchase lines and pick the batch when dispensing.

pharmacy_purchase_details.label: Detailed purchase entry
pharmacy_purchase_details.help: Free quantity, discount, GST, manufacture month, selling price and freight on supplier invoices, with taxable value and GST totals.

pharmacy_opening_stock.label: Opening stock entry
pharmacy_opening_stock.help: Enter the stock you already have when you start, without a supplier invoice.

pharmacy_supplier_returns.label: Returns to supplier
pharmacy_supplier_returns.help: Send damaged, expired or extra stock back to the supplier; stock goes down and it is recorded.

pharmacy_stock_alerts.label: Stock alerts (low, out, expiry)
pharmacy_stock_alerts.help: Out-of-stock, low-stock, expiring-soon and expired counts on the Stock tab and the Dashboard, with quick filters.

pharmacy_stock_ledger.label: Stock ledger screen
pharmacy_stock_ledger.help: One screen with every stock movement (in, out, returns, corrections) and opening / closing balance, filtered by medicine and dates.

pharmacy_stock_check.label: Physical stock check
pharmacy_stock_check.help: Count what is really on the shelves (all or one rack); differences are corrected and recorded.

medicine_extra_details.label: Extra product details
medicine_extra_details.help: Generic name, category, pack type and default selling price on the medicine form.

fees.title: Fees & services
fees.subtitle: OPD consultation fee of each doctor, and the services & charges list for OPD bills
fees.consultationHelp: New case = first visit, or the last visit with this doctor was longer ago than the follow-up days. Follow-up = seen by this doctor within those days. Put 0 for a free follow-up.
fees.followUpDaysHelp: A revisit within these days is charged the follow-up fee
fees.noDoctors: No doctors in this branch yet.
fees.servicesHelp: Procedures, Panchakarma, tests, certificates... that can be added to an OPD bill. Prices include GST. Health care services are usually GST-free - confirm with your CA.
fees.noServices: No services yet. Add your procedures and charges.
